text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(Ah—the runner list for the Japan Cup is 
out, huh.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(There's me... Opera O, and Doto too. And 
then—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: —Huh?

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Morniiing~... wait, huh? Where's Class Rep 
Top Road?

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, she's not here yet... actually, I 
heard she's absent today. I overheard the 
teacher talking about it earlier.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Seriously!? That's suuuper rare! What, a 
cold? I hope you're okay~.

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, well, word is she's not feeling well, 
but... more like, you know~...

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Don't you know? The story about the Japan 
Cup.

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
I heard Top Road-san couldn't make the 
starting lineup—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the afternoon, when it is time for 
training with her instructor or dedicated 
Trainer, she is usually already changed 
and waiting on the grounds.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was a girl who moved efficiently like 
that. —Normally, that is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Even just from that, it was instantly 
clear that something was going on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And seeing her gaze wander as if 
desperately searching for words, I was 
certain.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—It seems they have quite a lot they want 
to say.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
choice_data_list:
You understand your true self pretty well 
by now, don't you?

You've come to understand "yourself" quite 
well by now, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A season has passed since she opened up to 
me during Hatsumode. Now that she has 
sincerely "lived properly" in her own way 
up to this point—
choice_data_list: Tell me what you want to do.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Training... ...I want to take today off.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Because... I want to talk with Top 
Road-san.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...There you are.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Ayabe-san!? Huh... Why!? It's training 
time, you know!?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Same to you. If you were 'feeling under 
the weather,' I'd have thought you'd be 
resting in the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah... Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...I really shouldn't do things I'm not 
used to! Thinking I could slack off and 
feel refreshed, of all things...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't think of anywhere to go or 
anything I wanted to do, and before I knew 
it, I'd spent half the day just spacing 
out here...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...If so.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Want to try slacking off "properly" from 
now on?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Cosmetics...? Wait, Ayabe-san, were you 
interested in those...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Well... nothing in particular.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Right, you cut your own hair, don't you?! 
W-Why are you here, then...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Was this not the place? Then—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Uh, well~... It seems like this shop has 
some kind of special rules. Are you 
familiar with them, Ayabe-san...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Not particularly. Just—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
All I know is that if you order it, there 
are several items on the menu that will 
subject you to extreme humiliation.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: A-A minefield...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Right, you're not fond of noisy places, 
are you?! L-Let's leave, let's leave right 
away!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. I'm one to talk, but you're 
terrible at slacking off too, Ayabe-san!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Still—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much, for caring about 
me so much like this.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Still, um... really, I'm okay now!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It's true that I can't run in this Japan 
Cup! But that doesn't mean everything's 
over!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
So, um, well... ...I really should be 
heading home now!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to go on a quick run, so if 
you'll excuse me—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Wait.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Stay here.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Until it's night. ...Stay here with me 
until the stars come out."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two of them silently waited for the 
sunset just like that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Waiting, waiting, endlessly waiting, until 
finally—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...Ayabe-san. What do you call those four 
shining stars over there?"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
That is—the Autumn Quadrilateral. Also 
known as the "Great Square of Pegasus."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I see... A Pegasus, huh? That sounds nice 
and cool. Plus, it feels like I could fly 
super far away—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...I wanted to shine like that together 
with everyone too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Still... it seems it's rather difficult.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I... can't be like Opera O-chan, or like 
Doto-chan, and certainly not like 
Ayabe-san.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
No matter what I do, I can only ever be 
me... And it seems... this is as far as I 
go.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You can only ever be you, and nobody 
else... And that is why.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I want to compete with you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Uh—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Reliable, a good-natured meddler, a bit 
rough in her running, but powerful and 
popular with everyone.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Sincere enough to vow to meet 
expectations, yet prone to overthinking at 
times... I want... you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ngh, ...Ayabe-san.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Top Road-san.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Let us compete against each other again.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'll rest, get better, train hard, and 
then...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Let us compete together again—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (...—Ah, that's Top Road-san's hand.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(Once, I brushed it away. After a whole 
year, I could finally touch it.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(It's the hand of... my one and only 
rival.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: "—The Japan Cup. You have to come watch."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
And there... I'll deliver a run that makes 
you want to race against me once again.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: And I will win. ...So please.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...So, are you telling me to claw my way 
back up no matter what, just the way I am?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Even if I have to cough up blood, I'll 
make it to where you are?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Uh—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Well. That might be true.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "—Heh. ...Ahahahahaha!! Ahhhh, man!!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
This is the first time I've ever heard you 
be so selfish, Ayabe-san!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...That's true.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I think that's the first time in my life 
I've ever said that, too.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...How is it, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Wh-What do you think... ?! Though I feel 
like I might be able to slip right in 
now—"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hey now!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Found you, naughty little ponies! Honestly 
nowâ

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Skipping out and breaking curfew—did you 
enjoy your little taste of rebellion? Well 
then, allow me to throw in some 
disciplinary cleaning as a bonus!

text_block_list.name: Ayabe & Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.
